title: Teluni
html:
Teluni is a planned multi-tenant digital signage SaaS built on the Orion engineering foundation. It will let companies centrally manage images, videos, playlists and schedules on displays, with reliable offline playback. Brazil is the initial market, with international use anticipated. The core is intended for multiple business segments, from a single shop to a branch network.

Every screen. One place. · Todas as suas telas. Um só lugar.

Start with the product documentation for the vision, initial release policies/acceptance targets, accepted architecture directions, pending detailed design, risks and delivery phases. The name Teluni and principal domain teluni.app are approved; branding records the defensive teluni.com.br option, current exclusion of teluni.com, and the approved Connected Tiles identity. Domain registration/control evidence and trademark outcome remain pending. The owner approved initial commercial policies and validation prices; actual customer acceptance, costs, capacity and billing readiness remain unverified.

Current state

This repository was initialized on 2026-10-17 from Orion commit 53bcc705a9f68f01aa1bbea3a0f4df4a009577ea. It contains the foundation's architecture, policies, accepted ADRs, tooling, validation gate, CI, generated references, and Living Documentation Portal. The API and web application compose identity (Keycloak login, server-managed human sessions and OTP step-up) and the first organizations increment (companies, creator memberships, scoped standard-role access, branches and organization audit). The identity/access policies and D-01/D-02 designs are owner-approved. Tests use disposable Keycloak/PostgreSQL; real-environment provisioning and qualification remain pending.

The project plan and project human actions own this repository's current work and external prerequisites. The project manifest records the project identity, the immutable initialization commit, and the Orion baseline currently integrated. Project derivation explains how to inspect provenance and adopt newer Orion revisions through reviewed merges.

The initial product brief is documented. Membership administration, invitations, responsible-administrator approval/transfer, custom profiles, identity recovery qualification, media/programming/publication modules, the Android TV player and production deployment remain unfinished. The owner accepted the product architecture directions in ADR-0018–ADR-0021 and ADR-0023–ADR-0025 on 2026-10-18. The D-01 tenant data and D-02 identity/session designs were approved that day with an explicit request to implement PJ-24/PJ-03. Their implementation status and remaining work are recorded in the designs and plan; other detailed designs and release-readiness checks remain pending. No real-environment deployment is authorized by those approvals.

Accepted architecture and implemented capability are different states. Consult the technology map for selected directions and deliberately deferred choices, and validation availability for current checks. With Node.js 24.13.0 and pnpm 11.25.0, follow the canonical development setup for installation, local environment loading, execution, and the full gate.

Directory trees in architecture documents describe intended responsibilities, not proof that those directories exist. The physical repository takes precedence over illustrations. English is the canonical repository language; product localization is separate.
